data.description: Access your data with security, using our multi-datastore discovery module

prerequisites.title: MarathonLB (Modules dependencies)
prerequisites.description: Deploy a MarathonLB to correctly balance all the Discovery services. To access a service through the browser, please set the property General > 'HA Proxy host' + General > 'HA Proxy Path'

prerequisites.title: Database connection (Modules dependencies)
prerequisites.description: Postgres will be used to store the data of the configuration API, where the users environment and behaviour is defined. Please, check all the necessary properties that has been set in the the section General > Postgres.

prerequisites.title: Database connection (Modules dependencies)
prerequisites.description: Postgres will be used to store the data of the configuration API, where the users environment and behaviour is defined. Please, check all the necessary properties that has been set in the the section General > Postgres.

prerequisites.title: Pgbouncer (Modules dependencies)
prerequisites.description: Postgres connection pool service which provides access to Postgres database. It is preferred to connect through a connection pool

prerequisites.title: Create ACL User in Gosec
prerequisites.description: Create user for ACLS for the service being deployed (if user already in LDAP this is not required). The service user will match with Discovery Instance Name.

prerequisites.title: Discovery Postgres database
prerequisites.description: Postgres database needed to store all Discovery related metadata.

prerequisites.title: ACL creation request for a postgres service
prerequisites.description: ACL creation request with the permissions needed by Discovery to operate on a certain database

prerequisites.title: SSO (Service identity)
prerequisites.description: Discovery doesn't need it. Discovery has it's own authentication method.

prerequisites.title: Secrets (Service identity)
prerequisites.description: Checkout all the secrets that Discovery use in our documentation, it is automatically done by Command Center.

prerequisites.title: Vault role (Service identity)
prerequisites.description: A Vault role with the correct permissions is needed to access secret used by Discovery. In order to apply the correct permissions to the role check the secrets paths in our documentation. Please set the value in General > Service Identity > 'Vault role'.

prerequisites.title: Calico networks
prerequisites.description: Discovery can be set in a specific network. Please set the network name in General > 'Network name'.

nginxEventConnections.description: Sets the maximum number of simultaneous connections that can be opened by a worker process for Nginx configuration (i.e: worker_connections into events section)
nginxEventConnections.title: Event connections for Nginx

nginxWorkerProcesses.description: Sets the number of worker processes for Nginx configuration. The optimal value depends on many factors including (but not limited to) the number of CPU cores, the number of hard disk drives that store data, and load pattern. When one is in doubt, setting it to the number of available CPU cores would be a good start (the value “auto” will try to autodetect it).
nginxWorkerProcesses.title: Worker processes for Nginx

nginxClientMaxBodySize.description: Sets the maximum size of the body that Nginx accepts for CI/CD endpoint (This value corresponds to Nginx parameter :client_max_body_size)
nginxClientMaxBodySize.title: Max Body Size for CI/CD endpoint
